lessons.title: What is philosophy?
lessons.objective: Turn a familiar conviction into a question worth investigating.

lessons.title: Questions versus arguments
lessons.objective: Find the difference between asking, asserting, and supporting.

lessons.title: Deduction and induction
lessons.objective: Distinguish a guarantee from a well-supported expectation.

lessons.title: Validity and soundness
lessons.objective: Test the inference without confusing it with the truth of its premises.

lessons.title: Counterexamples
lessons.objective: Use a difficult case to test a general claim.

lessons.title: Argument Fundamentals
lessons.objective: Put a claim, its reasons, a counterexample, and a repair together.

lessons.title: The historical Socrates
lessons.objective: Meet a thinker through sources that do not speak with one voice.

lessons.title: Socratic questioning
lessons.objective: Find what a sequence of questions can—and cannot—establish.

lessons.title: Apology: the duty to philosophize
lessons.objective: Reconstruct a claim of obligation before accepting or contesting it.

lessons.title: Knowledge and ignorance
lessons.objective: Learn why recognizing a limit differs from denying all knowledge.

lessons.title: Crito: obligation and justice
lessons.objective: Ask whether suffering injustice licenses doing it.

lessons.title: Defend or criticize Socrates
lessons.objective: Interpret fairly, map the dispute, and answer an objection.
